widgetTool.name: acn-credit-card-widget
widgetTool.description: Emit the customer's existing credit card(s) with balance, limit, and payment details. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me pull up your card details.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False.

productDetails.description: Required. An ordered list of products to be displayed.

imageUris.description: A list of direct URLs to images displaying the product.

price.description: The current selling price of the product.

productId.description: The unique identifier for this specific product.

subtitle.description: A longer, secondary line of text for additional context.

title.description: Required. The primary name of the product as listed.

uri.description: The URL directing users to the full product detail page.
